rules.verify_against: npm run dev at http://localhost:3000, desktop width and 390px phone width. State resets on reload, so run each feature's steps from a fresh load.

status_legend.unverified: Code exists but the verification steps have not been run. Treat as not passing.
status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Standard startup and baseline verification
features.user_visible_behavior: A fresh session can run ./init.sh and get install, lint, typecheck, production build and a route smoke test, ending with the dev server command.
verification: Run ./init.sh from the repo root.
Verify lint and typecheck report no errors.
Verify next build succeeds.
Verify scripts/smoke.sh prints ok for every route and redirect and ends with 'Smoke test passed.'
Change one expected title in a copy of scripts/smoke.sh and verify it fails and stops its server.
evidence: 2026-10-19: ./init.sh ran clean. Lint 0 problems, tsc 0 errors, next build OK (14 static pages, /reviews/[id] and /archive/[id] partial prerender).
2026-10-19: smoke ok for /, /sign-in, /reviews, /reviews/new, /reviews/r-104, /archive, /archive/r-102, /members, /settings, 404 page, and /dashboard, /documents, /reports redirects.
2026-10-19: negative check with a wrong /settings title printed FAIL and 'Smoke test failed.'; port 3100 was free afterwards.
features.notes: Set up in session 001. See claude-progress.md.

features.title: README matches the current routes
features.user_visible_behavior: README's route table lists the screens that exist and says which old routes redirect where.
verification: Compare the README route table with the folders under app/ and redirects() in next.config.ts.
Verify every listed route is in scripts/smoke.sh and passes.
evidence: 2026-10-19: README table updated to /, /sign-in, /reviews, /reviews/new, /reviews/[id], /archive, /archive/[id], /members, /settings plus the three redirects; all covered by the passing smoke run.
features.notes: README still listed /dashboard, /reports and /documents as screens after they were folded into Reviews and Archive (commit 07fcc7f).

features.title: Landing page with scripted product demo
features.user_visible_behavior: The landing page shows the hero, then a scripted demo of the app (moving cursor on desktop, taps on phones), then the feature rows, pricing and final call to action.
verification: Open /.
At desktop width, verify the demo under the hero plays with a moving cursor and loops without layout jumps.
At 390px width, verify the phone demo plays with taps instead of a cursor.
Scroll to the bottom and verify every section renders with no horizontal scroll.
Verify the nav's sign-in link goes to /sign-in.
features.notes: Scripts for the demo are at the top of components/sections/ProductShot.tsx and MobileDemo.tsx; engine in demo.tsx.

features.title: Client copy and order feedback on the landing page (2026-10-19)
features.user_visible_behavior: The landing page shows the client's revised copy in the hero, problem, how-it-works, feature and audience sections. The product demo tabs run Review setup, Findings, Export on desktop and phones, and play in that order.
verification: npm run verify passes.
Open / at desktop width. Check the hero pill reads 'For subsea umbilical engineering teams' and still links to #pricing, and the subheading says 'flags'.
Check the desktop demo tabs read Review setup, Findings, Export and the demo starts on Review setup, then moves to Findings, then Export.
At 390px width, check the phone demo tabs read Setup, Findings, Export and play in that order.
Check the problem, How a review works, hours-to-minutes, non-compliances and audience sections show the client's text word for word, apart from the agreed grammar and full stop fixes.
Check the audience note sits under the heading at desktop and phone width.
Check no section overflows horizontally at 390px and the stat row doesn't wrap awkwardly.
evidence: 2026-10-19: npm run verify passed after all changes (lint, typecheck, build, smoke).
2026-10-19: in Chrome at 1440px, all 22 new strings found word for word in the rendered page; none of the 7 old strings remain. Hero pill text correct, href #pricing, 'Learn more' kept.
2026-10-19: desktop tabs read Review setup, Findings, Export, with Review setup first and active. Logged autoplay cycling Review setup -> Findings -> Export -> Review setup.
2026-10-19: in a 390px frame, phone tabs read Setup, Findings, Export; autoplay logged Setup @0s -> Findings @8.5s -> Export @15.5s -> Setup @21s.
2026-10-19: no horizontal scroll at 390px or 360px. Audience note sits under the heading at both widths. No console errors after console tracking started (it began after the first page load).

2026-10-19: layout fixes found during the check: 'Minutes' overflowed its stat cell on phones (109px text, 95px room), so stat values are now 20px under sm (78/86px at 360). The disclaimer's last word was orphaned (fixed with text-balance). 'non-compliances' and 'add-on' broke at the hyphen (kept whole with whitespace-nowrap). The audience heading widened from 560px to 720px once the note moved under it.
features.notes: Agreed with the user: pill keeps 'Learn more' link to pricing; phone demo reordered too; stat '~5 min' becomes 'Minutes'; 'takes' fixed to 'take'; body sentences get full stops, headings don't; 'PDF or Word' kept as the client wrote it (matches Pricing; the app prototype only exports PDF and a comment sheet).

features.title: Sign in (prototype)
features.user_visible_behavior: A user fills in the sign-in form and lands on /reviews. No credentials are checked.
verification: Open /sign-in.
Verify the brand panel shows at desktop width and is hidden at 390px.
Toggle the password visibility button and verify the field switches between hidden and shown.
Submit the form and verify the browser lands on /reviews.
From /reviews, use Sign out in the sidebar and verify it returns to /sign-in.
features.notes: Front end only. Real auth is auth-002.

features.title: Reviews in progress list
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees the current project's non-archived reviews with results, export status, reviewer and date, and can search them.
verification: Open /reviews.
Verify the list shows the sample project's Complete reviews (r-104, r-103) with results summaries and 'Exported' or 'Ready to export' pills.
Type part of a document name into search and verify the list narrows.
Type a term that matches nothing and verify the 'Nothing matches' empty state.
Click a review and verify it opens /reviews/<id>.

features.title: Start a new review (wizard)
features.user_visible_behavior: A user steps through Document, Umbilical scope, Project scope, and Standards and upload, then starts a review and lands on its progress screen. A revision that has already been reviewed can't be started again.
verification: Open /reviews/new.
Verify the stepper shows the wizard steps and step 1 is pre-filled so Continue is enabled.
On each step, clear a required choice and verify Continue disables with the matching hint, then restore it.
On the last step, remove the file and verify 'Add the PDF to continue.'.
Start the review with the pre-filled Rev C file and verify the browser lands on /reviews/r-105 showing 'Checking your document'.
Go back to /reviews/new, reach the last step and verify the same file now shows 'Already reviewed' with a link to the existing review.
features.notes: Draft and ids live in AppContext, so this must be run in one page session without reloading.

features.title: Review progress (simulated run)
features.user_visible_behavior: A running review shows progress through its checks for about 9 seconds, then shows the findings with a 'Review complete' toast. It can be cancelled or skipped to results.
verification: Start a review from /reviews/new.
Verify the progress percentage and checklist advance and the toast 'Review complete' appears after about 9 s.
Start another review and click 'Skip to results (demo)'; verify the findings appear straight away.
Start another review and click 'Cancel review'; verify it returns to /reviews and the review is not listed.

features.title: Findings: filter, search, comment, hand over, export, archive
features.user_visible_behavior: On a complete review a user filters findings by kind, searches, opens a finding's detail, adds a comment, changes the reviewer, exports the comment sheet or PDF, and archives the review.
verification: Open /reviews/r-104.
Click each filter tab (All, Non-compliant, Missing information, Compliant) and verify the counts match the rows shown.
Search '6.3.2' and verify only the matching finding remains.
Open a finding, add a comment, close it, and verify the comment shows in the row.
Change 'Reviewed by' and verify the toast 'Handed over to <name>'.
Click the comment sheet export and verify a file downloads, the toast says 'Comment sheet downloaded' and the details panel no longer says 'Not exported yet'.
Open /reviews/r-104?finding=<id> directly and verify that finding's detail opens.
Archive the review, confirm in the dialog, and verify the browser lands on /archive/r-104 with the toast 'Review archived'.
features.notes: The PDF export calls window.print(), which opens a native dialog that blocks browser automation. Check it by hand or skip it and record that.

features.title: Archive list and archived report
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees archived reviews, opens one to see details, history and a report preview, and can reopen it as a review.
verification: Open /archive and verify r-102 and r-101 are listed with reviewed and archived dates.
Search the list and verify it narrows, and that a non-matching term shows the empty state.
Open /archive/r-102 and verify Details, History and the Report preview render.
Open /archive/r-104 (not archived) and verify the 'Not in the archive' state links to the review.
Reopen r-102, confirm, and verify it lands on /reviews/r-102 with the toast 'Review reopened'.

features.title: Members
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees the project's members and former members and can remove a member after confirming.
verification: Open /members and verify current members and seat usage show.
Click the add-member button and verify the toast about asking the company administrator.
Remove a member, confirm in the dialog, and verify they move to Former members with a toast.
Verify reviews they ran still show their name in the archive.

features.title: Project settings and default standards
features.user_visible_behavior: A user renames the project and changes its default standards, and the next new review starts with those standards ticked.
verification: Open /settings, change the project name and a default standard, save, and verify the toast 'Settings saved'.
Verify the sidebar shows the new project name.
Open /reviews/new, go to the last step and verify the standards match the new defaults.

features.title: App shell: navigation, project switcher, mobile menu
features.user_visible_behavior: The sidebar shows Reviews, Archive (with counts), Members and Settings, highlights the current page and switches projects. On phones a menu button opens the same navigation.
verification: On /reviews at desktop width, click each nav link and verify the active highlight follows.
Switch to the second project and verify the browser goes to /reviews and the list shows that project's reviews.
At 390px width, open the menu, navigate, and verify the menu closes; close it again with the close button.
Verify /dashboard, /documents and /reports redirect to /reviews, /reviews and /archive.

features.title: Real authentication
features.user_visible_behavior: Sign-in checks credentials and app routes are only reachable when signed in.
features.notes: Listed under 'Not wired up yet' in README. Needs a product decision on the auth provider before it can be specified; write verification steps then. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/authentication-with-cache-components.md first.

features.title: Persist reviews, uploads and the review job
features.user_visible_behavior: Uploaded documents, reviews and findings survive a reload and come from a real review job instead of the sample result set.
features.notes: Listed under 'Not wired up yet' in README. Replaces the in-memory state in components/app/AppContext.tsx. Needs backend and API design first; split into smaller features before starting.

features.title: Demo request form submission
features.user_visible_behavior: Submitting the demo request form sends the request somewhere the team will see it and confirms to the visitor.
features.notes: Listed under 'Not wired up yet' in README. Needs a destination (email, CRM) decided first.
